name: Edgewood Tahoe Resort
insider_take: Where alpine luxury meets championship golf on the crystal-clear shores of America's most pristine alpine lake.
whats_special: Edgewood Tahoe is home to the only lakeside golf course on Lake Tahoe, featuring the famous 17th hole that plays directly along the shoreline. The resort sits at 6,224 feet elevation, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Sierra Nevada mountains. This is also the annual host venue for the American Century Championship celebrity golf tournament, where A-list celebrities and former athletes compete each July.
pro_tip: Book a lakefront suite during summer months to watch the celebrity golf tournament from your private balcony - many guests spot famous faces practicing on the course below.
dont_miss: The resort's pristine private beach with complimentary kayaks and paddleboards, plus the award-winning spa featuring treatments using locally-sourced Tahoe elements. Take the scenic drive to nearby Emerald Bay State Park, consistently ranked as one of the most photographed spots in the world for its stunning turquoise waters and Vikingsholm castle.
pros: Stunning lakefront location with panoramic Lake Tahoe views
Championship golf course designed by George Fazio
Luxury spa with comprehensive wellness treatments
Multiple dining venues including award-winning restaurants
